gloss: body slam; throwing oneself wholeheartedly into something

definitions.gloss: body slam; ramming with one's body; body check
definitions.explanation: Striking an opponent or object by hurling one's whole body against it.

definitions.gloss: tackling something wholeheartedly; an all-out, fearless approach
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, throwing oneself into a task or challenge with one's whole being, holding nothing back.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}に{体当|たいあ}たりする。
examples.english: To slam one's body into the opponent.

examples.japanese: ドアに{体当|たいあ}たりして{開|あ}けた。
examples.english: I rammed the door with my body to open it.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}は{相手|あいて}に{体当|たいあ}たりして、ボールを{奪|うば}い{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The player body-checked the opponent and won the ball back.

examples.japanese: {体当|たいあ}たりで{挑|いど}む。
examples.english: To take it on with everything you've got.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{体当|たいあ}たりの{演技|えんぎ}が{評価|ひょうか}された。
examples.english: Her wholehearted, all-out performance was praised.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}ながら、どんな{仕事|しごと}にも{体当|たいあ}たりで{取|と}り{組|く}む{姿勢|しせい}が{頼|たの}もしい。
examples.english: Though a newcomer, his attitude of tackling any job with all his might is reassuring.

notes:
Compound of {体|からだ} (body) + {当|あ}たり (hitting). Used with する as a verb. Sense 1 is physical; sense 2 is the very common figurative idea of giving something your all without hesitation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体当|たいあ}たりする: to ram with the body
- {体当|たいあ}たりで{挑|いど}む: to take on with all one's might
- {体当|たいあ}たりの{演技|えんぎ}: an all-out, fearless performance
